description: [DEEP] Fix off-by-one error in binary search
request: Fix the binary search implementation in search.py. The current implementation has an off-by-one error: it uses `mid = (lo + hi) / 2` (float division) and `hi = len(arr)` but then compares with `arr[mid]` which will crash on an empty list and return wrong results. Fix it to use integer division, initialise hi correctly, and handle the not-found case by returning -1.
